_about: Everyday situations for training. Each branch names an official source and keywords; train/scenarios.py picks the best-matching sentence from that source's real text, so every quote is verbatim. The `when` labels, openers and question wording are the only hand-written parts. `side` says which party a branch mainly helps, used for balanced answers and for negotiation suggestions. Review with: python -m train.scenarios --show

branches.about: landlord responsible maintaining good state of repair fit for habitation

branches.when: If the tenant, someone living there, or a guest damaged it on purpose or through carelessness
